description: thuthesis 7.7.1 (2026/05/26, CTAN and MiKTeX), the Tsinghua University thesis class. It is built on ctexbook, needs XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX, and is one column with chapters. degree=bachelor gives the one-page undergraduate cover: the graduate degrees add an English title page, and every cover field has a default value, so \maketitle needs no \thusetup. fontset=fandol picks the Fandol CJK fonts and TeX Gyre Latin fonts, so nothing depends on which system fonts are installed. math-font=none stops the class loading unicode-math with XITS at the end of the preamble: that code runs \newcommand\square, which fails once the document has loaded amssymb.
